sloka: स निश्चितार्थः परिवीरहन्ता समीक्ष्यकारी विनिवृत्तचेष्टः ।परैः प्रसह्याभिगतैर्निगृह्य ननाद तैस्तैः परिभर्त्स्यमानः ।। ५.४८.४६।।।।
transliteration: sa niścitārthaḥ parivīrahantā samīkṣyakārī vinivṛttaceṣṭaḥ ।paraiḥ prasahyābhigatairnigṛhya nanāda taistaiḥ paribhartsyamānaḥ ।। 5.48.46।।।।

translations.english: Then the ogres had Hanuman, the subduer of enemies, who made no effort to move, bound with hemp rope and bark robes.
